coverage.scope: Three fitting Windows managed routes; no new platform qualification or Project promotion

entries.selected_route: Existing ready staged-source-portable capability 23; managed compatible Windows runtime replacement
entries.update_owner: Portcove for new managed copies; external copies remain user/upstream owned
entries.setup_provider: Explicit Play invokes upstream first-launch setup; Core never executes a discovered helper
entries.data_boundary: Choose Play to open the upstream launcher and supply your own matching original GBA game and retail GBA BIOS. Portcove manages compatible Windows beta runtime replacements and preserves local settings, input pointers, user game.toml and local saves/ when that save mode is selected. Normal cartridge saves and optional state slots follow your selected original game file, usually outside the installation: back up that actual folder separately, including recovery siblings. Portcove backups do not include external originals, BIOS or saves. Generated executable caches and diagnostics stay with the runtime that produced them and are not carried into a replacement. Runtime rollback carries current declared data; it does not rewind saves or guarantee older readers can use newer data. Keep the packaged variants and compiler companions with their runtime; customized external data paths need separate preservation.
entries.delivery_status: Source candidate; final independent review, exact-head hosted checks and guarded merge pending
entries.limits: External originals/BIOS and default original-adjacent saves are outside backup. No managed mod package claim. States retain upstream reader limits; updates do not auto-load them. Other GBA candidates require separately reviewed mod-coexistence and, for Mario Kart, same-host credential preservation.

entries.data_boundary: Supply your own matching NTSC-U USA big-endian original when Portcove requests it. Core verifies and copies that exact file; choose Play for the game’s own asset preparation. Portcove manages compatible Windows runtime replacements and preserves the declared original, EEPROM, settings, emulator-import backups and screenshots, including before first Play. Backups include your original game file. Generated sidecars, shader warmup lists, conversion staging and diagnostics stay with their producing runtime and are regenerated when needed. Optional source/Python tool output and custom paths require separate preservation. Runtime rollback carries current declared data; it does not rewind saves or guarantee older readers can use newer data. Upstream conversion and emulator import retain their own error/recovery limitations.
entries.delivery_status: Source candidate; final independent review, exact-head hosted checks and guarded merge pending
entries.limits: No actual original or game execution. Upstream converter failure handling is imperfect; Core does not certify generated outputs. EEPROM importer has 99 backup names and can overwrite its last slot when full; all 99 are preserved by managed replacement. Optional Python bytecode remains an undeclared-addition preservation hold.
